record.question: Which of the following test method is correct for the determination of mineral ash in coal?
options: By heating an accurately weighed sample of the coal in an adequately ventilated muffle furnace at temperatures in the range 700 to 750oC.
By heating an 1g of coal in ventilated muffle furnace at temperatures in the range 500 to 600oC.
By heating an 1g of coal in a platinum crucible at 500 to 600oC for 7 minutes.
By heating 1g of coal weighed in a platinum crucible with a close- fitting cover at 950±20oC for exactly 7 minutes, the resultant loss (excluding losses due to water) in weight is mineral ash.
